title: Open Questions of Memory Politics and the 2026 Election
grammar: Recap: indirect questions with -e and question words
goal: I can state the open questions of memory politics before the election of 2026 (*vitatott, mérték, nyitott kérdés*).
I can report an open question with *-e* or with a question word.
I can give the result of the election of 12 April 2026 and the election of the prime minister on 9 May (*mandátum, vereség, Országgyűlés*).
